title: 第一卷 第21章 本尊踏马来辣第一卷 第22章 雷师兄和苏师妹太坑了
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
苏明月说完，便很努力站了起来。
既然不能继续休息，那她就将坚韧顽强的形象表现到底，雷子越肯定会更心疼她，等到上了灵山，会将所有她想要的机缘送到她的面前。
雷子越心疼，但也没办法。
只是一脸不悦地对身后众人道：“作为玄天宗弟子，同门被别宗弟子欺负，要一致对外，维护自家宗门尊严。”
一众玄天宗弟子低低道：“……是。”
心里却瘪了瘪嘴。
虽然雷子越说在休息的时候会认真讲解机缘出现的各种现象，可实际上大部队从停下来到现在，他不是在安慰苏明月就是在指挥擅长冰属性法诀的弟子做冰块出来给苏明月敷脚。
根本就没有说灵山秘境机缘相关的话题。
现在被筱风蓝一通嘲讽后，苏明月这个千娇百宠的小师妹竟然愿意走路了！
别说一致对外，维护自家宗门尊严。他们感谢筱风蓝还来不及，心里甚至恨不得把筱风蓝绑起来拴在队伍前面，求她再多说几句，好让苏明月快快跑起来！
怎么可能对她生出什么意见？
在雷子越的连搀带哄下，玄天宗弟子们又跟着浩浩荡荡前进了四里左右的路程。
山路上已经没有其他宗门队伍的影子了
有弟子开始后悔没有跟洛还真他们一起走，以至于一个半时辰了，他们还没能走完这短短十里上山路。
对于洛还真不听话先走，还大言不惭说自己来当领队这个事儿，雷子越心里也有点意见。
于是冷笑一声，不慎在意地安抚众人：“放心吧，他们就算提前上了山，所获得的机缘和宝物，也绝对不会比我们多。”
“因为灵山秘境的机缘，除了藏在七十二宫殿中外。还有一部分宝物会以寻常活物的方式，大摇大摆出现在我们面前，比如山雀、游鱼、老虎、兔子……之类的。他们的本体其实是灵石、珍贵精矿或者是仙草灵药。”
众弟子闻言，疑惑道：“那我们怎么分辨是寻常活物，还是宝物呢？”
一个一个捕捉猎杀的话，未免也太没效率了一点吧。
雷子越微微一笑，“你们会庆幸你们选择留下来陪我和明月师妹的。因为接下来我要教你们的，便是如何分辨它们。”

“宝物化作的活物，不论是飞禽走兽还是虫蚁植物，只要它们出现，周围灵气就会微妙地波动起来，变得比之前稍微浓郁一些。”
这个事情知道的人不多。
雷子越也是因为在宗门里的身份比较高，有机会来这个秘境三次，才彻底摸清楚这个规律。
而这也是雷子越有底气给苏明月兜底的原因之一。
“话说，你们有没有感觉，现在四周的灵气就有点隐隐波动？”
“好像是比刚才浓郁一些了哈。”
议论声中，山路旁边的灌丛发出窸窸窣窣的声音，所有弟子顿时屏住呼吸，目光朝声音的方向看去——
一只半人高的大兔子从灌丛冒了出来。
而随着兔子的出现，原本波动的灵气果然非常明显地浓郁了几分。它似乎受了惊吓，两腿一蹬，一溜烟儿地朝远方逃窜去了。
“这是，化作活物的宝贝……？”
“追！！！”
“你们往西边，你们往东边，我们一起合力抓住它！”
在雷子越的指挥下，众弟子一哄而散，卯足了劲儿奔跑，开始追那只兔子。
“明月，你脚疼，咱们慢慢走，不着急。”雷子越扶着苏明月说，“等抓到那只兔子，二师兄就做主将它送给你，为你第一次出秘境添个好彩。”
content_en:
After Su Mingyue finished speaking, she stood up with great effort.
Since she can't continue to rest, she will show her tough and tenacious image to the end. Lei Ziyue will definitely feel sorry for her even more. When she reaches Lingshan, all the opportunities she wants will be presented to her.
Lei Zi felt more and more distressed, but there was nothing he could do.
He just said to the people behind him with an unhappy face: "As a disciple of Xuantian Sect, if my fellow sect is bullied by disciples of other sects, we must act unanimously to protect the dignity of our sect."
A group of Xuantian Sect disciples said in a low voice: "...Yes."
In my heart, I frowned.
Although Lei Ziyue said that he would carefully explain various phenomena that occur by chance during the break, in fact from the moment the army stopped to the present, he was either comforting Su Mingyue or directing his disciples who were good at ice attribute magic to make ice cubes and put them on Su Mingyue's feet.
There was no talk about the chance of Lingshan Secret Realm at all.
Now, after being ridiculed by Xiao Fenglan, Su Mingyue, a doting little junior sister, is actually willing to walk!
Not to mention unanimously speaking to the outside world and safeguarding the dignity of one's own sect. They thanked Xiao Fenglan before it was too late, and they even wished they could tie up Xiao Fenglan and tie her to the front of the team, begging her to say a few more words so that Su Mingyue could run quickly!
How could he have any opinion against her?
With Lei Ziyue's guidance and coaxing, the Xuantian Sect disciples followed the mighty march forward for about four miles.
There are no traces of other sect teams on the mountain road.
Some disciples began to regret not walking with Luo Huanzhen and the others, so much so that after an hour and a half, they still couldn't finish the short ten-mile hike up the mountain.
Lei Ziyue also had some objections to the fact that Luo Huan really disobeyed and left first, and even boasted that he would be the team leader.
So he sneered and calmed everyone carelessly: "Don't worry, even if they go up the mountain early, they will definitely not get more opportunities and treasures than us."
"Because of the opportunity of the secret realm of Lingshan, in addition to being hidden in the seventy-two palaces, there are also some treasures that will appear in front of us in the form of ordinary living creatures, such as tits, swimming fish, tigers, rabbits... and the like. Their bodies are actually spiritual stones, precious concentrates, or fairy grass elixirs."
When the disciples heard this, they wondered: "Then how can we tell whether it is an ordinary living thing or a treasure?"
It would be too inefficient to capture and kill them one by one.
Lei Ziyue smiled slightly, "You will be glad that you chose to stay with me and Junior Sister Mingyue. Because what I want to teach you next is how to distinguish them."
"The living creatures transformed from treasures, whether they are birds, animals or insects, ants and plants, as long as they appear, the surrounding aura will subtly fluctuate and become slightly richer than before."
Not many people know about this.
Because of his relatively high status in the sect, Lei Ziyue had the opportunity to visit this secret realm three times before he fully understood this rule.
And this is one of the reasons why Lei Ziyue is more confident to give Su Mingyue the answer.
"Speaking of which, do you feel that the spiritual energy around you is slightly fluctuating now?"
"It seems to be a little richer than before."
During the discussion, the bushes beside the mountain road made a rustling sound. All the disciples immediately held their breath and looked in the direction of the sound——
A large rabbit half as tall as a man emerged from the bushes.
And with the appearance of the rabbit, the originally fluctuating spiritual energy became obviously stronger. It seemed to be frightened, kicked off its legs, and fled away into the distance.
"Is this a treasure that has turned into a living creature...?"
"Chasing!!!"
"You go west, you go east, we work together to catch it!"
Under Lei Ziyue's command, the disciples dispersed in a hurry, ran with all their strength, and began to chase the rabbit.
"Mingyue, your feet hurt, let's walk slowly, don't be in a hurry." Lei Ziyue supported Su Mingyue and said, "When we catch that rabbit,The second senior brother will take the initiative to give it to you to make your first trip out of the secret realm a blessing. "
